messages:
Maria G.: Morning team — starting the Solanova onboarding thread. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 4‑week timeline. I’ll own kickoff & stakeholder intro.
Ashley K.: Thanks Maria. Who from Product/Integrations should we include?
Maria G.: @Noah R. for integrations, @Devin T. for enablement. I’ll invite exec sponsor (internal) and Solanova's ops lead in the actual kickoff meeting invite.
Noah R.: I can cover the API mapping doc and sample config. ETA to get a draft over? I can do a first pass today.
Devin T.: I’ll prepare a 30/60/90 enablement plan and a short runbook for support handoff.
Maria G.: Core success criteria proposed: 1) model endpoints integrated in staging, 2) end-to-end latency < 200ms median on typical flows, 3) first 1000 prod tokens processed without errors, 4) two internal users trained on Console. Thoughts?
Ashley K.: Criteria look good. Add "baseline quality check" — embedding similarity avg > 0.82 on our seed prompts.
Devin T.: Agree. Also flag renewal risk: Solanova wants a dedicated capacity quote if latency checks out. We should capture pricing expectation early.
Noah R.: Noted. I’ll add a short section in the API doc about sample payloads and expected throughput.
Maria G.: Draft kickoff agenda (30m):
```
- 5m intros & roles
- 10m high-level onboarding timeline (4 weeks)
- 10m integrations & sandbox access steps
- 5m open Qs / next actions
```

Maria G.: Proposed 4‑week timeline (high level):
- Week 0: kickoff + access + baseline eval prompts
- Week 1: integrations in staging + streaming tests
- Week 2: performance tuning (batching/quant) + obs dashboards live
- Week 3: go/no-go for dedicated capacity + enablement sessions

Ashley K.: Can we surface any known risks? I’ll add a short risk register in the doc. Quick ones: customer-side rate limits, SSO delays, and sample data redaction.
Maria G.: Good call. Assign owners in the doc: access = Maria, API mapping = Noah, enablement = Devin, pricing/renewal touch = Ashley.
onboard-bot: Reminder set — kickoff meeting invite to be sent in 30m.
Devin T.: I’ll also capture feedback loop cadence: weekly async check-ins + one formal health check at week 2.
Maria G.: Perfect. Action items: Noah — upload API draft by EOD; Devin — enablement plan by tomorrow; Ashley — draft pricing note for Dedicated by Thurs; Maria — send invites + stakeholder list now.
Ashley K.: Acknowledge. I’ll ping finance for a ballpark.
Maria G.: Thanks all — will post the Confluence link here once I create the playbook. :thumbsup:
